description: Source code for a Markdown report generator class used in Playwright testing framework, including methods for summarizing test results and writing reports to a file.

classes.name: MarkdownReporter
classes.description: A reporter class that generates Markdown formatted test reports for Playwright test results.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the MarkdownReporter with given options.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter outputs to standard IO; returns false.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Sets up configuration and suite references at the start of reporting.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Records fatal errors encountered during testing.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Generates and writes the final Markdown report after test execution completes.

methods.name: publishReport
methods.description: Writes the generated report string to a file, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: _generateSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary object categorizing test outcomes for reporting.

methods.name: _printTestList
methods.description: Formats and appends a list of tests to the report lines.
